title: 长定语与三个并列 doing 结构
source: 01 2023-06 第1套 中国文化产品走向世界
chinese: 中国政府出台了一系列政策鼓励和支持更多具有中国元素的优秀文化产品走出国门,扩大海外市场份额,进一步提升中国文化的世界影响力。
backbone: 主语：中国政府；谓语：出台；宾语：一系列政策。
modifiers: “具有中国元素的”修饰文化产品；“走出国门、扩大份额、提升影响力”是三个递进动作。
skeleton: The Chinese government has introduced a series of policies.
steps: 先加 to encourage and support more outstanding cultural products；再用 featuring Chinese elements 后置修饰 products；最后用 entering, expanding, and enhancing 保持并列。
english: The Chinese government has introduced a series of policies to encourage and support more outstanding cultural products featuring Chinese elements in entering overseas markets, expanding their market shares, and further enhancing the global influence of Chinese culture.
rule: 中文“的”串先定中心词，长修饰语后置；同一主体的连续动作用并列非谓语保持结构对称。
phrases: the global influence of Chinese culture.
reviewNote: 搭配建议（未改动原译文）：encourage ... in entering 的搭配较生硬。可改写为 “… policies to encourage more outstanding cultural products featuring Chinese elements to enter overseas markets and to support them in expanding their market shares, thereby further enhancing the global influence of Chinese culture.”，使 encourage … to do 与 support … in doing 更清楚。

title: 句首方式状语与主句骨架
source: 02 2023-06 第2套 城市公共设施
chinese: 通过兴建新的广场、公园和公共绿地或对原有公共场地重新加以规划改造,许多城市为市民提供了更多休闲和社交的场所。
backbone: 主语：许多城市；谓语：提供；宾语：更多场所。
modifiers: “通过……”是方式状语；“为市民”是受益对象；“休闲和社交的”修饰场所。
skeleton: Many cities have provided residents with more places.
steps: 句首用 By building ... or redesigning and renovating ...；句尾加 for leisure and social activities。
english: By building new squares, parks, and public green spaces, or redesigning and renovating existing public areas, many cities have provided residents with more places for leisure and social activities.
rule: 方式状语较长时可放句首，之后立即给出主语；By doing 的逻辑主语必须是 many cities。
phrases: new squares, parks, and public green spaces,

title: 多个谓语的并列组织
source: 03 2023-06 第3套 城市环境与高质量发展
chinese: 中国持续开展城市生态修复和功能修补,全面实施城镇老旧小区改造,大力推进城市园林绿化,消除污染。
backbone: 主语：中国；谓语：开展、实施、推进、消除；宾语：各项城市治理工作。
modifiers: 持续、全面、大力分别修饰动作；“城镇老旧小区”是改造对象。
skeleton: China has continued to improve its cities.
steps: 将笼统的 improve 展开为 restore, improve, renovate, expand, reduce，全部使用平行动词。
english: China has continued to restore urban ecosystems and improve city facilities, renovate old residential neighborhoods, expand urban green spaces, and reduce pollution.
rule: 同一主语的多个动作不必重复主语；动词形式保持平行，最后两项用 and 连接。

title: 中文无主句改为英语被动并列
source: 04 2023-12 第1套 多元化养老模式
chinese: 可以通过政府引导和社会参与,建立更多更好的养老服务机构,改进社区服务中心,鼓励居家自助养老。
backbone: 中文没有明说施事者。核心动作是建立机构、改进中心、鼓励居家养老。
modifiers: “通过政府引导和社会参与”是条件或方式。
skeleton: More institutions can be established, service centers improved, and home-based care encouraged.
steps: 句首加 With government guidance and public participation；第二、三项省略重复的 can be。
english: With government guidance and public participation, more and better elderly care institutions can be established, community service centers improved, and home-based self-care encouraged.
rule: 中文无主句且施事者不重要时，优先让受事对象做英语主语，使用被动语态。
phrases: With government guidance and public participation,
more and better elderly care institutions

title: 方式状语与结果分词
source: 05 2023-12 第2套 人口老龄化与社会保障
chinese: 通过改革社会保障制度,政府不断增加社会保障经费,逐步扩大社会保障覆盖范围,使更多老年人受益。
backbone: 主语：政府；谓语：增加、扩大；宾语：经费、覆盖范围。
modifiers: “通过改革……”是方式；“使更多老年人受益”是前面两个动作的结果。
skeleton: The government is increasing funding and expanding coverage.
steps: 句首用 By reforming ...；句尾用 allowing more older people to benefit 表结果。
english: By reforming the social security system, the government is steadily increasing social security funding and expanding coverage, allowing more older people to benefit.
rule: “使……”若表前句的自然结果，可用逗号 + doing；若表目的，则优先用 to do。
phrases: By reforming the social security system,
allowing more older people to benefit.

title: 长定语改为后置分词和同位语
source: 07 2024-06 第1套 中国传统婚礼
chinese: 婚礼场地经过精心装饰,以象征喜庆的红色为主色调,摆放着许多祝愿新人幸福的物件。
backbone: 主语：婚礼场地；谓语：被装饰、摆放着；宾语：物件。
modifiers: “象征喜庆的”修饰红色；“祝愿新人幸福的”修饰物件。
skeleton: Wedding venues are decorated and filled with objects.
steps: 用 usually in red 表主色调；用 a color symbolizing joy 同位说明 red；用 objects that convey wishes ... 后置修饰 objects。
english: Wedding venues are carefully decorated, usually in red, a color symbolizing joy, and filled with objects that convey wishes for the newlyweds' happiness.
rule: 短修饰语可前置，长修饰语放中心词后；补充说明一个名词时可用同位语。
reviewNote: 表达建议（未改动原译文）：red 后的同位语插在两个并列被动结构之间，阅读略有停顿；可用破折号标出 a color symbolizing joy。现有句子可作语法分析，无需强制修正。

title: 原因状语与结果 doing 结构
chinese: 竹子具有强大的生命力和适应能力,无论环境多么恶劣,都能够顽强生存,因而寓意坚韧不拔的精神。
backbone: 主语：竹子；谓语：能生存；结果：成为坚韧的象征。
modifiers: “具有强大生命力和适应力”是原因；“无论环境多么恶劣”是让步状语。
skeleton: Bamboo can survive, making it a symbol of perseverance.
steps: 原因放句首：Thanks to its strong vitality and adaptability；让步简化为 even in harsh environments。
english: Thanks to its strong vitality and adaptability, bamboo can survive even in harsh environments, making it a symbol of perseverance.
rule: 中文因果链不必重复 because/therefore；可用句首介词短语表原因，句尾 doing 表结果。
phrases: Thanks to its strong vitality and adaptability,

title: 使役结构 enabling 与名词化
source: 10 2024-12 第1套 北斗卫星导航系统
chinese: 研发人员经过不懈努力,攻克了一系列技术难题,北斗系统最终实现了全球覆盖和高精度定位。
backbone: 主语：研发人员；谓语：攻克；宾语：技术难题。
modifiers: “经过不懈努力”是方式；“北斗实现……”是攻克难题后的结果。
steps: 句首用 Through tireless efforts；句尾用 enabling BeiDou to achieve ... 把两个主语关联起来。
english: Through tireless efforts, researchers overcame a series of technical challenges, enabling BeiDou to achieve global coverage and high-precision positioning.
rule: enable + object + to do 用来表“使某对象能够……”；不要写 enable somebody do。

title: 不定式被动与距离状语
chinese: 自主研发的码头管理系统可以在百公里之外对大型设备进行远程操控。
backbone: 主语：码头管理系统；谓语：可以操控；宾语：大型设备。
modifiers: “自主研发的”修饰系统；“在百公里之外”和“远程”表地点和方式。
skeleton: The system enables equipment to be operated.
steps: 用 independently developed 前置修饰 system；因 equipment 是被操控的对象，用 to be operated；地点放句尾。
english: Its independently developed terminal management system enables large-scale equipment to be operated remotely from more than 100 kilometers away.
rule: enable A to be done 适用于 A 承受动作的情况；方式副词通常放动词后，距离状语放句尾。
reviewNote: 上下文说明（未改动原译文）：Its 指代原篇目的洋山港，单独练习时可理解为“洋山港的”。若独立成句，可把 Its 换为 Yangshan Port’s。

title: 被动主干与 covering 范围补充
chinese: 天宫空间站已实施180多个科学研究与应用项目,涉及空间生命科学、太空医学、空间材料科学等领域。
backbone: 主语：180多个项目；谓语：已实施；地点：天宫空间站。
modifiers: “涉及……领域”补充项目范围。中文用空间站作主语，英语可用项目作主语。
skeleton: More than 180 projects have been carried out.
steps: 地点放句尾 aboard the station；项目范围用 covering fields such as ...。
english: More than 180 scientific research and application projects have been carried out aboard the station, covering fields such as space life sciences, space medicine, and space materials science.
rule: 英语主语应选择与谓语关系最清楚的对象。当施事者不重要时，用项目 + 现在完成时被动。
phrases: More than 180 scientific research and application projects
reviewNote: 上下文说明（未改动原译文）：the station 指天宫空间站。若独立成句，可写 aboard the Tiangong space station。

title: not only 的平行结构
source: 14 2025-06 第2套 粤港澳大湾区
chinese: 大湾区不仅将建成充满活力的世界级城市群和具有全球影响力的国际科技创新中心,还将打造成适合工作、购物、旅游的优质生活圈。
backbone: 主语：大湾区；谓语：将被建成和打造成；表语：城市群、创新中心、生活圈。
modifiers: “充满活力的”修饰城市群；“具有全球影响力的”修饰中心；“适合……的”修饰生活圈。
skeleton: The Greater Bay Area will be developed into A and B.
steps: 用 not only into A and B, but also into C，使 not only 与 but also 后都是 into + 名词短语。
english: The Greater Bay Area will be developed not only into a vibrant world-class cluster of cities and an international science and technology innovation center with global influence, but also into a high-quality living area suitable for working, shopping, and traveling.
rule: not only/but also 后的成分必须平行。为避免头重脚轻，可把公共的 will be developed 放在 not only 前。
phrases: a vibrant world-class cluster of cities
and an international science and technology innovation center
suitable for working, shopping, and traveling.

title: Since 时间状语与三个结果分词
source: 15 2025-06 第3套 南水北调工程
chinese: 自2014年通水以来,工程向北方调水累计已超500亿立方米,为北方地区的人民提供了可靠的水资源,同时也极大地改善了这一地区的生态环境,促进了经济的可持续健康发展。
backbone: 主语：工程；谓语：已调水；宾语：500亿立方米以上的水。
modifiers: “自2014年以来”决定现在完成时；“提供、改善、促进”都是调水带来的结果。
skeleton: Since 2014, the project has transferred water to the north.
steps: 数量放宾语中；后面三项用 providing, improving, and promoting 并列。
english: Since water deliveries began in 2014, the project has transferred more than 50 billion cubic meters of water to the north, providing people there with a reliable water supply, greatly improving the local environment, and promoting sustainable and healthy economic development.
rule: Since + 过去时从句，主句常用现在完成时。三个同级结果用同形 doing 并列。
phrases: more than 50 billion cubic meters of water

title: 现在完成时与现在分词结果
chinese: 改革开放以来,中国在自强自立的征程上,持续加大科研投入,在信息技术、人工智能、航天工程等领域不断取得新突破。
backbone: 主语：中国；谓语：持续加大；宾语：科研投入。
modifiers: “改革开放以来”是时间状语；“取得新突破”是投入带来的伴随结果。
skeleton: Since reform and opening-up, China has increased investment in research.
steps: 句尾用 making new breakthroughs in ...；领域列举放在 in 后。
english: Since reform and opening-up, China has steadily increased its investment in scientific research in its pursuit of self-reliance, making new breakthroughs in information technology, artificial intelligence, aerospace engineering, and other fields.
rule: “以来”通常触发现在完成时；中文第二个谓语若是结果，可转为 making 短语。

title: 动名词主语与 allows 宾语补足语
source: 19 2026-06 第1套 远程医疗与科技医疗
chinese: 电子健康档案的普及让医生能够快速了解患者病史,避免重复检查。
backbone: 主语：电子健康档案的普及；谓语：让；宾语：医生；动作：了解病史、避免检查。
modifiers: “快速”修饰了解；“患者的”修饰病史。
skeleton: The widespread use of records allows doctors to learn and avoid examinations.
steps: 用 widespread use 将“普及”名词化；allows 与单数中心词 use 一致；learn 和 avoid 并列。
english: The widespread use of electronic health records allows doctors to quickly learn about patients' medical histories and avoid unnecessary repeated examinations.
rule: 中文抽象主语可用 the use/development/popularization of 名词化；谓语单复数看中心词 use，不看 records。
phrases: The widespread use of electronic health records
reviewNote: 原文解析勘误：标题“动名词主语”不准确。The widespread use of electronic health records 是以名词 use 为中心词的名词短语，不是动名词结构。英文参考译文本身无需因此修改。

title: which 关系从句解释新概念
source: 20 2026-06 第2套 电子商务与乡村振兴
chinese: 近年来,直播带货使城市消费者能够与卖家实时互动,已成为促进农村发展的一种新方式。
backbone: 主语：直播带货；谓语：已成为；表语：一种新方式。
modifiers: “使城市消费者能够与卖家实时互动”是对直播带货功能的解释；“促进农村发展的”修饰方式。
skeleton: Live-streaming commerce has become a new way to promote rural development.
steps: 把功能说明放在主语后，用 which allows urban consumers to interact with sellers in real time。
english: In recent years, live-streaming commerce, which allows urban consumers to interact with sellers in real time, has become a new way to promote rural development.
rule: 当一段信息只是解释前面的名词且去掉后主句仍完整，用逗号 + which 非限定性从句。

title: 被动语态与 capable of doing 后置修饰
chinese: 无人机已被国家纳入战略性新兴产业,逐步成为能满足多种场景需求的智能助手。
backbone: 分句一：无人机产业 + 已被纳入 + 战略性新兴产业。分句二：无人机 + 成为 + 智能助手。
modifiers: “能满足多种场景需求的”是长定语，修饰智能助手。
skeleton: The industry has been included ..., and drones are becoming intelligent assistants.
steps: 第一分句用被动；第二分句用 capable of meeting ... 后置修饰 assistants。
english: The drone industry has been included among the country's strategic emerging industries, and drones are gradually becoming intelligent assistants capable of meeting the needs of various scenarios.
rule: 当中文一句包含两个明确主体时，英语可用 and 连接两个完整分句；长定语改为形容词短语后置。
phrases: among the country's strategic emerging industries,
